markBrief: The Arabic word هوية alone. No separate symbol and no Latin lettering in the logo or loader. Colors are DGA Platforms Code theme variables.

wordmark.distribution: Outlined SVG paths only; source TTF and OFL are offline artwork inputs. No runtime font dependency.
wordmark.uiTypography: IBM Plex Sans Arabic and IBM Plex Sans unchanged

loader: Arabic wordmark itself, reconstructed handwriting: hāʾ hook, outer bowl and inner stroke; joined wāw head and tail; pen lift; yāʾ flowing into the tāʾ marbūṭa stem and loop; then the two-dot strokes below yāʾ and above tāʾ marbūṭa. Exact outline retained, counters kept open. Transparent primary and white GIFs; 3.6-second loop, 90 frames at 25 fps; full-word hold, clear and restart without reverse erasing; static reduced-motion fallback.
scope: Hawiyah, a UI library built to comply with the DGA Platforms Code. Upstream fonts retain their SIL Open Font License. Hawiyah is not an official DGA product; no trademark clearance is implied.
